decisive_items: multiple encysted pleural effusions in the right lung
Thoracentesis yielded pale yellow fluid with 1260 WBCs/µL (87% neutrophils), 1590 RBCs/µL, pH 7.237
Pleural biopsy showed empyema without granulomas
response.rationale: Encysted empyema is directly supported by CT findings and pleural fluid characteristics; R1 is the broader diagnosis, while other candidates lack specific support or have contradictions.

rejected.why: Less specific than R1C, which adds encysted distribution
Pneumonia is too broad; empyema is the specific complication
Quantiferon and AFB negative, no granulomas
Diabetes is background, not the diagnosis
Pleurisy is a symptom, not the underlying empyema
Rash and leukocytosis nonspecific, no SLE criteria
Rash alone insufficient for diabetic dermopathy
Bacterial pneumonia is less specific than empyema
